decisions.reason: Responsive website templates are adjacent to the firm's customer base but are relatively easy to commoditize and are less central than hosting, support, and platform tools, so resources are better focused elsewhere.
Premium customer support fits the firm's core promise of expert managed service and 24/7 help and is therefore strategically important to retain.
A software version management tool strengthens the firm's technical administration offering and likely supports customer retention even if it may evolve within the broader platform.

The data processing contract tool is the most distant from the firm's core hosting and service business, making it the clearest candidate to discontinue and reallocate effort to core products and new development.
Scalable hosting for agencies was presented as a flagship direction and is tightly aligned with the firm's capabilities, growth plans, and target customers.
